verdict.rationale: Fern is explicitly a SDK generator platform producing type-safe, idiomatic client libraries in 9+ languages (TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, C#) from a single API spec, with pagination helpers and other SDK-native features, positioning it squarely for AI-native developers to build against generated official SDKs; community corroboration (HN) confirms it delivers end-to-end SDK generation. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of SDK quality/reliability across all languages, and clearer evidence of long-term maintenance/versioning guarantees for generated SDKs.
